title: Discovering Learning Rules that Shape Others
abstract: arXiv:2611.08335v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: In general-sum games, self-interested learners can reach outcomes that are poor for everyone, which has motivated methods that shape the opponent's learning. Methods like Learning with Opponent-Learning Awareness (LOLA), which differentiates through the opponent's learning process, and Model-Free Opponent Shaping (M-FOS), which uses model-free optimisation methods for long-horizon opponent shaping, have enabled mutual cooperation and exploitation of learners. However, these methods require access to the opponent's parameters, policy, rewards or learning rule during deployment. In single-agent reinforcement learning, update rules discovered by meta-learning have achieved state-of-the-art results (e.g. DiscoRL). These rules are separate from the policy they train and read only the agent's own experience. translated_title: 发现能够塑造他人的学习规则
translated_abstract: 在一般和博弈中，自利的学习者可能达成对所有人都不利的结果，这促使了塑造对手学习方法的发展。诸如“具有对手学习意识的学习”（LOLA，通过对对手的学习过程进行微分）和“无模型对手塑造”（M-FOS，使用无模型优化方法进行长时程对手塑造）等方法，已经能够实现相互合作以及对学习者的利用。然而，这些方法在部署时需要访问对手的参数、策略、奖励或学习规则。在单智能体强化学习中，通过元学习发现的更新规则已经取得了最先进的成果（例如DiscoRL）。这些规则与它们所训练的策略相互分离，并且只读取智能体自身的经验。我们在此通过引入“用于对手塑造的发现更新规则”（DUOS）将这一框架扩展到一般和博弈设置中。据我们所知……
tldr: 该论文提出DUOS方法，将元学习发现的更新规则框架从单智能体强化学习扩展到一般和博弈中的对手塑造，无需访问对手的参数、策略、奖励或学习规则即可实现对手塑造。
